selection.candidates: 355 retained canonical candidate records: 172 legacy-source records were prefiltered using available positive profile endpoints because those sources have no common calculable field, and 183 newer-source records carry calculable=true
selection.profiles: 699 complete activity-specific records with positive frame counts, equality between frame_count and converged_frames, successful upstream status where available, and empty error fields
selection.frames: 3515 converged scan frames within the 699 complete profiles

record_semantics.candidate_identity: candidate_id is unique across the 355 retained records
record_semantics.composition_boundary: public columns do not establish 355 unique material compositions; metal identities, oxidation states, source-site lineage, and source design family are not released
record_semantics.design_occupancy: 38 of 100 requested design indices are represented; empty indices are not failure or yield denominators

inputs.note: Fingerprints describe source tables used to build the public canonical tables; the source tables themselves are not included in this directory.

snapshot_files.selection: The builder intersected 536 private structure images with retained candidates having at least two complete profiles, yielding 179 eligible records, and selected the record closest to the eligible-set median score with deterministic design_index and candidate_id tie-breaking; it did not explicitly filter for x57 or the highlighted 13.0 A/NS/105 degree window.
snapshot_files.provenance: The representative scans were extracted from private raw result records and are not derivable from profiles.csv alone; representative selection also depended on a private structure-image availability pool.

reproducibility_boundary: The public package supports released report, figure, and statistical verification but not full upstream campaign reconstruction.
